gui.guhs.safari.ranger.hallo: Hello there, junior ranger! I'm Guhmbo, head ranger of Safaripark Vadse Bergen. Can I help you with anything, njeg?
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.optie.tip: Got a tip of the day?

gui.guhs.safari.ranger.uitleg: Spot and photograph every animal for your Safari-dex! At the experts' pavilion you get a badge when a zone is full. In the petting corner you can help out, in the gift shop you shop with Safari coins, and in the lodge you sleep like a log. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.verkoper.hallo: Welcome to the gift shop! Everything for Safari coins, and nothing is too chonky.
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.hallo:
Hi! I'm Knuffelien from the petting corner. Today they fancy:
%s
Will you help? Feeding, brushing, or walking the alpaca on the lead!
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.optie.voer: May I have a bag of food?
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.voer: Here you go: a bit of everything, plus a brush and a lead if you didn't have them yet. Guess what they like today, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.voer.al: You already had a bag today, chonk. Tomorrow again!
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.1: Welcome to Safaripark Vadse Bergen! I'm Guhmbo, the head ranger. So glad you're here, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.2: More than forty kinds of animals live here, from lions to sloths. Some hide really well, so look around carefully.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.3: Photograph them for your Safari-dex: the nicer the photo, the more Safari coins.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.3.camera: Here's your camera! Photograph the animals for your Safari-dex: the nicer the photo, the more Safari coins.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.4: The experts in the pavilion, the petting corner, the gift shop and the lodge: have a look everywhere. Njeg, happy spotting!
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.aaihoekvoer: A handful of food for the petting corner (4).
gui.guhs.safari.winkel.blauwdrukken.uitl: Build the lodge, the ranger post or the lookout tower at home. Coming soon, chonk!
